note: group math is the closest of the five atlas groups; the page is chemistry

description.zh: 前四周期主族元素的原子半径、电离能、电负性热图与趋势，用斯莱特有效核电荷解释；含例外，不含过渡金属。
description.en: Atomic radius, ionisation energy and electronegativity heat maps and trends for main-group elements of periods 1–4, explained with Slater effective nuclear charge; includes exceptions, no transition metals.

reason.zh: 分子构型页用电负性差给出键偶极，进而判断分子极性。
reason.en: The molecular-shapes lesson uses electronegativity differences as bond dipoles to decide molecular polarity.

reason.zh: 有效核电荷越大，对外层电子的静电吸引越强，半径越小。
reason.en: A larger effective nuclear charge attracts outer electrons more strongly and shrinks the radius.

reason.zh: 拟合直线给出总体趋势，残差显示个体偏离，是回归思想的小例子。
reason.en: The fitted line gives the overall trend and the residuals show individual deviations, a small example of regression thinking.

title.zh: 为什么越往右原子越小？
title.en: Why do atoms get smaller toward the right?
